subject: Mini-grant rollforward + promo pricing exception for SeedGrid Labs
messages:
From: Dana Park <dana@seedgrid.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Mini-grant rollforward + ask on promo stacking

Hi Vivek / Lauren,

Thanks again for the intro last week. SeedGrid Labs runs a 6-week hardware + software accelerator and we awarded 10 teams a $2k mini-grant each for cloud credits earlier this year. Two of those teams didn't ramp and want to roll the unused credits forward into dedicated sandbox credits to run longer experiments.

High level ask: can Redwood allow up to 60% of the remaining mini-grant pool to be converted into sandbox/dedicated discounts for the two teams? They'd prefer a quick path (no new contract) because they are on tight timelines for investor demos.

Attached: seedgrid-mini-grant-request.docx (proposal).

Key constraints from our side:
- We cannot sign long-term commitments for these teams.
- We can approve a short-term conversion if Redwood can bundle with a promotional 10% SANDBOX discount.

Open to ideas on how to structure a short-term Exception without breaking the accelerator promo rules.

Thanks,
Dana
Dana Park
Program Director, SeedGrid Labs
--
SeedGrid Labs | seedgrid.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Dana Park <dana@seedgrid.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mini-grant rollforward + ask on promo stacking

Dana,

Appreciate the clear summary and the doc. Quick read-through, and I think there is a path here that balances fiscal guardrails with SeedGrid's timeline. A few clarifying Qs before I loop legal/finance:

1) How many total dollars are we talking (exact remaining $ figure)?
2) Do the teams have any existing Redwood accounts or are these brand-new signups?
3) Timeline: do they need conversion completed by Dec 20 to hit demo timelines?

If the remaining pool is small (< $6k) we can probably do a manual rollforward + promo stacking approval without a new contract. If larger, we may need a quick amendment/one-pager.

I'll loop Lauren for commercial guardrails and Ben for any promo-exception approvals.

Cheers,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
--
Redwood Inference | redwood.com
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Dana Park <dana@seedgrid.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mini-grant rollforward + ask on promo stacking

Thanks for the details, Vivek & Dana. Standard commercial position below to speed internal review: 

- We can allow a one-time conversion of unused accelerator credits into equivalent sandbox credits up to an aggregate $10k per accelerator cohort, provided the teams do not accept any additional long-term reserved commitments at signing.
- Promotional stacking: we typically don't stack cohort promos on top of sandbox onboarding discounts. However, we can consider a capped, time-limited promo exception: 10% off sandbox usage for 30 days post-conversion, limited to $1,500 value per team.
- Compliance note: we need to ensure these conversions do not change billing entity / tax treatment; finance will need invoice metadata to show original mini-grant origin.

Ben, if the ask stays within the $10k cohort cap and the 30-day, $1,500-per-team promo cap, can you sign off on a commercial exception? If not, please advise what threshold requires legal/contract amendment.

Dana: please confirm the exact remaining pool and the teams' Redwood account status and I will draft a short exception sheet.

Regards,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Commercial Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Dana Park <dana@seedgrid.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mini-grant rollforward + ask on promo stacking

Lauren — thanks for the summary. I can approve an exception under the following stricter operational terms:

- Cap the conversion to $5k aggregate for SeedGrid's cohort (conservative given precedent).
- Allow the 10% sandbox promo stacking for 30 days, but limit redemption to $1,000 per team (not $1,500).
- Require a signed one-page Amendment of Grant Conversion (template attached) that:
  - records original mini-grant IDs,
  - ties converted credits to the recipient team's account, and
  - sets an expiration date (60 days for the sandbox credits).

I attached the term sheet to speed turnaround: mini-grant-rollforward-term-sheet.xlsx (attachment stub).

If SeedGrid confirms acceptance of the cap and the quick one-page amendment is acceptable, we can turn this around next week.

Ben Carter
Head of Startup Programs
Redwood Inference
From: Dana Park <dana@seedgrid.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mini-grant rollforward + ask on promo stacking

Ben / Vivek / Lauren — great, appreciate the clarity and the template. SeedGrid confirms the cohort has $4,200 remaining in unused mini-grants across the two teams, both are new signups with no existing Redwood accounts, and the conversion needs to be executed before Dec 22 for their demo schedules.

We accept the $5k aggregate cap, the $1,000 per-team promo cap, and the requirement for the one-page amendment. Can you send the one-pager and an invoice line showing the origin of the credits? If we get the amendment today (or Monday), we can provision accounts and start conversions next week.

Thanks again — will await the one-pager.

Dana
Program Director, SeedGrid Labs
